title: GitHubForge.compare parity: tree-diff-primary mode-bearing diff + authenticated listFiles + resolveEnforcement extraction
acceptance: GitHubForge.compare returns mode-bearing DiffEntry[] derived from base+head recursive git trees (never from compare files[], which carries no modes and has a ~300-file cap with no truncation flag), satisfying the parity contract: same changed-path SET (both rename sides) and same per-path git object MODES as LocalGitForge.compare under the canonical Map<path,{baseMode,headMode}> form with 000000 for absent; rename-vs-(add+delete) attribution need not match and never will by construction (renames surface as A+D); no tier/coverage consumer reads DiffEntry.status (verified at cd951d9: computeTierFloor reads changedPaths + newMode only; computeUncoveredPaths takes a flat path list)

envelope semantics (GPT amendment 1, adjudicated): absent() when base or head cannot be resolved to a commit/tree; throw on malformed first-party tree data - truncated:true, missing path/mode/type/sha, unknown type or mode, invalid (type,mode) pairing (blob only 100644|100755|120000; commit only 160000; tree only 040000 and filtered), or duplicate raw path in one tree response (amendment 3: the floor is driven by newMode, so a malformed pairing must never synthesize a plausible entry). NEW consumer contract defined by this task (verified at cd951d9: no enforcement path consumes compare's envelope today - cli parses raw git output at cli.ts:296,393): the Gate treats any non-ok compare result as blocking before tier/coverage decisions; absent is not a pass; the conformance suite pins this. No silent partial diff ever reaches a tier or coverage decision

commit->tree resolution goes through the Commits API (commit.tree.sha), not commit-SHA leniency on the trees endpoint; CompareResult.status sourced from the compare API top-level status field (per_page=1; vocab ahead|behind|identical|diverged matches CompareStatus exactly), with that response's files[] ignored entirely

GitHubForge.listFiles implemented from the same recursive-trees surface, replacing unsupported() (QRM-4.0 prerequisite [11]); forge-mode reference resolution becomes possible; CLI remains --local in this task

resolveEnforcement extracted from cli.ts into the kernel behind an explicit PolicySource seam, parameterized over ForgeAdapter (audit F5 + GPT amendment 2, verified: loadPolicy reads the WORKING-TREE policy at cli.ts:141-153 while --policy=head resolves references at HEAD): enforcement = policyAtRef(canonicalForkPoint) with references at the same ref; diagnostic = policyFromWorkingTree() with references at HEAD; forge mode exposes NO working-tree diagnostic. Protected by a regression test where working-tree .quorum/policy.json differs from HEAD's and tier --policy=head output semantics are unchanged. Local-mode behavior byte-identical; existing 219-test suite green with only import-path churn

a parameterized ForgeAdapter conformance suite (audit F6 + GPT amendments 4/5) encodes the contract as executable bytes: (a) compare parity - canonical-form equality over a committed synthetic fixture repo covering A/M/D/R100/R<100/mode-only-chmod/typechange-file-to-symlink/symlink-add/gitlink-add-bump-absorb/spaces/non-ASCII/empty-diff (Architect prototype 2026-07-05: 13/13 PASS with real parseRawDiff as oracle, including whole-repo quorum history span); (b) listFiles parity, acceptance-level and separate from compare parity - same leaf-path set as LocalGitForge.listFiles including symlink and gitlink leaves, which is what makes resolveReferencedFloors' fail-closed contract HOLD in forge mode rather than merely stop failing; (c) malformed tree-response fixtures each asserting fail-closed: truncated:true, missing path/mode/type/sha, unknown type, unknown mode, invalid (type,mode) pair, duplicate raw path, and a normalizePath-rejected path (absolute/traversal/NUL) so the repo's hard-rejection layer fires through the forge path too; plus one recorded live authenticated GitHubForge-vs-LocalGitForge parity run against real quorum commits in the handoff doc

Builder confirms first-party under App auth BEFORE implementation and records response bytes in the handoff: (B1) trees API mode/type/sha/path/truncated fields and accepted mode value set, (B2) compare top-level status vocab, (B3) trees size limits with truncated as the sole overflow signal; pinned-constant rule - nothing implemented from memory

recorded residual, fail-safe direction (audit F3): resolveCommit's delta-membership check reads one unpaginated page of compare commits[]; a >250-commit branch can misread a pushed commit as absent (blocks, never under-floors); fix rides any later touch of that path
known shared semantics unchanged: deletion of a gitlink/symlink does not mode-floor (newMode 000000) - adjudicated QRM-3.1 behavior, identical in both forge modes, parity verified (prototype C4..C5)

carried amendment rides this task's T0 bookkeeping (ratified 2026-07-05): QRM-4.0 item [3] gains 'no PR-influenced state (caches, artifacts, restored dependencies) enters the verifier's execution context; verifier workflow actions pinned to SHAs; pull_request, never pull_request_target' - cache poisoning across the fork/base trust boundary is PR influence without running PR-head code (live incident class, 2025-26)
satisfies QRM-4.0 prerequisites [5] and [11] and unblocks [4]; does NOT claim [1] base-policy-read wiring, [2] branch-freshness, [3] trusted verifier, or the Gate itself (principle 2)
